concepts.label: Set Search Index Advanced Settings
concepts.reused_or_minted: reused - existing extraction-layer id (20 prior mentions). This page is the old-generation (fts/) description of the same Advanced panel that search/set-advanced-settings.md documents for the current generation: both describe a Default Type, a Default Analyzer, a Default Date/Time Parser and a Default Field setting for the index/bucket. This page predates the 8.0 scoring-model choice (search:scoring-model) that set-advanced-settings.md now also covers in the same panel - not present here at all, since this page has no bm25/tf-idf mention. Same task, older and narrower content, not a separate concept.

relations.evidence: **Default Analyzer**: The default analyzer to be used for this bucket. The default value is `standard`.

relations.subject: search:set-advanced-settings
relations.evidence: **Default Date/Time Parser**: The default date/time parser to be used for this bucket. The default value is `dateTimeOptional`.

relations.subject: search:set-advanced-settings
relations.evidence: **Default Field**: The default field for this bucket. the default value is `_all`.

notable_absence.finding: This page's Advanced panel has no Scoring Model field at all - no tf-idf/bm25 choice, no search:scoring-algorithm-enum reference, nothing. That setting (search:scoring-model, promoted from search/set-advanced-settings.md) is documented as living in the SAME Advanced panel in the current-generation docs. Since this fts/ page and the current search:set-advanced-settings.md page describe what is stated to be the identical UI panel, the absence is a genuine content gap between the two generations' accounts of one panel, not a sign that this page is about something different - it simply predates the 8.0 scoring-model addition to that panel. Also absent: 'Store Dynamic Fields' and 'Index Dynamic Fields', the two checkbox settings this page lists, have no corresponding availableSince or effect-detail beyond the one-line description quoted ('When checked, ensures inclusion of field-content in returned results...'); no default value is stated for either, unlike the four other fields on this page.

cross_component_finding: No cross-component finding on this page - its content is entirely scoped to one Search index configuration panel.
cross_product_finding: Not among the round's 14 pages with a confirmed 7.2 exact-filename twin, but it is the fts/ (old-generation) twin-in-substance of search/set-advanced-settings.md: same four core fields (Default Type/Analyzer/Date-Time Parser/Field) under the same 'Advanced' panel name. The scoring-model field that search:scoring-model and search:scoring-algorithm-enum were promoted from is absent here entirely, confirming this page reflects an earlier state of the same panel rather than a different panel.
